soot_exit_proxy.definition: Mean outward flue soot mass flow divided by mean outward flue plus mouth soot mass flows.
soot_exit_proxy.interpretation: Share of modelled soot leaving through these two measured planes during the same interval. Not a fraction of generated soot: storage, deposition, re-entry and other exits are not accounted for. Not a prediction of real wood-smoke emissions or capture efficiency.

c1_v4_two_rotating__central.gas_uniformity_proxy: Maximum minus minimum of the measured mean gas temperatures at the recorded probe locations. This compares local gas exposure, not pizza temperatures, heat flux, cooking time or doneness.
